note: One entry per photo window. `file` is the base name in src/assets/photos/ (any image extension). Until that file exists the window shows its coded daylight. `position` is the focal point kept in view when the window crops the frame; for a door it is also the point the closed door is centered on. `wide` is the focal point used where the same frame fills a wide band (a door page's hero). `alt` describes the frame that is in the window.

home-hero.alt: A bright office in the morning. A man leans in beside a colleague at her laptop, another works at the next desk, and two people talk by the window.

beat-morning.alt: A man opens a laptop on a kitchen table at home in the morning.

beat-evening.alt: At dusk, a woman with her coat on closes her laptop while colleagues pack up behind her.

beat-night.alt: The same office at night, empty, with one lamp on and city lights beyond the windows.

beat-dawn.alt: An empty desk by a window at first light, with a closed laptop, a notebook and the chair pushed in.
